sloka: नरान्तकः क्रोधवशं जगाम हतं तुरङ्गं पतितं निरीक्ष्य।स मुष्टिमुद्यम्य महाप्रभावो जघान शीर्षे युधि वालिपुत्रम् ।। ६.६९.९५ ।।
transliteration: narāntakaḥ krodhavaśaṁ jagāma hataṁ turaṅgaṁ patitaṁ nirīkṣya।sa muṣṭimudyamya mahāprabhāvo jaghāna śīrṣe yudhi vāliputram ।। 6.69.95 ।।

translations.english: Naranthaka, the foremost of the heroes, having been killed in combat, the Devatas and gods of the three worlds experienced great joy.
